how_to_grade: Eval 1 produces a film: run `python evals/grade_film.py "<studio>" <film> --out grading.json` (it re-measures the delivered file, runs the dry run, and checks that the engine was not edited), then have a person watch the film beside the two example films. Evals 2 and 3 are graded by reading what was changed and what was said. The baseline for a film is not a run without the skill (that would mean a second renderer on the same PC): it is the same stretch of the older film, set beside the new one with `node tools/compare.mjs`.

evals.name: new-stretch-end-to-end
evals.prompt: here's a 16 second stretch of my GGSP narration - big_break_vo.wav, the word level srt and the script for it. make the short for this stretch with the business-story-short skill. the studio is already set up. don't stop to ask me things, make the calls yourself and list them at the end
evals.expected_output: A 1080x1920 30 fps MP4 with a full mix of about 15.6 s (the tightened voice), an effects-only MP3 and the tightened voice file; one new world (a dead factory in Kutch that comes back to life) built to the look of the two example films; 'December 2017' and other type verbatim and on its word; the dry run, the motion audit and the mix checks all passing; a report listing trims, sounds, unconfirmed spellings and known weak spots.
assertions: the project type-checks and the dry run passes for the new film
no sequence is joined to the one before by a bare cut
the engine and the tools are as the skill delivered them
a board with beats, a STATE.md and a rendered cast sheet exist
the film, the effects-only MP3, the tightened voice and report.md are in out/<film>/deliver/
the film is H.264 yuv420p bt709, 1080x1920 at 30 fps, AAC 48 kHz stereo, as long as the tightened voice
loudness is -14 LUFS give or take 0.6 and the true peak is at or under -1 dB
every check in the mix report is true and the effects-only file is not silent
the motion audit shows 1 % or fewer held frames inside a move, 8 % or less near-still time with no stretch over 1.25 s, and no flash frames
the report lists the trims, and every sound used is listed with a preview link
a person finds that a still of the new film could be cut next to a still of the example films (same light, same figures, same type)
every word on screen is the narrator's, and the reply lists the decisions made, what is unconfirmed, and the known weak spots

evals.name: remix-without-rerender
evals.prompt: the music in the minus degre short is too loud under the last line, and the thud when the oven lands is a bit much. fix the mix and give me the new file, don't touch the picture
evals.expected_output: Only src/films/md/sound.json changes (the music's keys or level near the last line, the thud layers' pk); the mix is rebuilt with audio_mix.py and passes every check; deliver.mjs is run again on the existing finished picture; no render is started; the reply says what was changed by how many dB and that it was done by measurement.
assertions: only src/films/md/sound.json was edited
no render or still was started (no browser launched)
audio_mix.py was run and every check in its report is true
deliver.mjs was run again and the new file passes its checks
the reply says which levels changed and by how many dB, and that the balance was set by measurement, not by ear

evals.name: new-film-start-and-stop-a
evals.prompt: new story, 95 seconds, founder of a bakery chain. vo.mp3 and words.srt attached, no script file. can you start on it and tell me how long it'll take
evals.expected_output: A new film scaffolded with new-film.mjs; words.py run and words.png looked at; the narration read with script.ts; a board in sequences and beats with joins, type moments verbatim from the narration, and a cast list; the cast sheet and one style frame per world rendered; names and spellings listed for confirmation because there is no script; a time estimate; and a stop for the user's go-ahead before any sequence is animated.
assertions: a time estimate is given in the first reply, before the long work starts
the film is scaffolded with new-film.mjs and words.py has been run and its picture looked at
the board cuts the narration into sequences and beats, with a planned join between each pair of sequences
every type moment on the board is verbatim from the narration, and no number is invented
names and spellings are listed for the user to confirm, because there is no script file
a cast sheet and one style frame per world are rendered and sent with the board
the limits that the story runs into (draped clothing, long hair, children, crowds, non-Latin type) are said on the board, not after the build
work stops for the user's go-ahead before any sequence is animated
